summary: Medirom Healthcare Technologies filed a Form 6-K disclosing an amendment to a deemed loan agreement with Kufu Company Holdings. The amendment refinances JPY 275 million of convertible bonds by converting the principal into a loan, raising total loan principal to JPY 475 million. The loan bears 10% interest, matures December 31, 2026, and remains secured by a pledge of all shares of subsidiary MEDIROM MOTHER Labs. No asset sale, merger, or tender offer occurs; this is a debt restructuring/refinancing event. Watch for potential defaults or share pledge enforcement if the company fails to repay.
